Who We Are   
 Rising Edge Group is an electrical contracting company founded in 2002, specialization in high-voltage electrical solutions that power critical infrastructure across North America. With operations in both Canada and the United States, we partner with clients across the electrical utilities, renewable energy, and industrial sectors to design, build, and maintain the critical infrastructure systems communities and industries rely on.   
 Driven by a clear vision to strengthen the stability, reliability, and advancement of energy infrastructure, we take pride in delivering work that matters. Guided by our STRIDE values - Safety, Teamwork, Responsibility, Integrity, Deliver, and Excellence - we foster a people focused culture of growth, mentorship and collaboration where safety always come first.  
 What You'll Do   
 The Lead Project Controller serves as a senior technical resource within the Project Controls function, promoting the consistent application of project controls practices and providing guidance on complex or non-routine matters. The position supports Project Controllers in cost control, forecasting, earned value, cash flow, scheduling, risk and change management, and reporting. The role does not include direct supervisory or people-management responsibilities.
 To maintain sufficient capacity for technical leadership, complex project support, and participation in major estimates, the Lead Project Controller will typically carry a reduced portfolio equivalent to 30–50% of a standard Project Controller workload. This will generally include up to two Project Manager assignments and may be reduced further as technical support or estimating demands increase. Where practical, a limited portfolio will be retained to maintain a direct connection to project execution.
 As Rising Edge continues to expand, the Lead Project Controller will contribute to the development of practical, scalable Project Controls standards, tools, and processes. The successful candidate will be motivated by the opportunity to help shape a growing function and will be comfortable working in an environment where established processes continue to evolve. The role requires sound judgment and initiative to develop solutions that can support the organization as it scales.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Technical Leadership and Support 
 Serve as the senior technical resource for Project Controllers, Junior Project Controllers, and Project Assistants on complex Project Controls matters.
 Support complex forecasting, earned value, cash flow, scheduling, cost-control, change-management, and reporting issues.
 Review or advise on high-risk and technically complex deliverables, and help troubleshoot unusual project, contract, system, or reporting conditions.
 Coach team members through complex work while the assigned Project Controller retains ownership of routine project deliverables.
 Identify recurring technical gaps and convert them into practical standards, examples, training content, or process improvements.
 Escalate material technical or Project Controls risks to the Supervisor or Manager. The role provides technical guidance but does not assign work, manage performance, or hold administrative authority.
 Cost Control Forecasting and Performance Measurement 
 Provide advanced cost-control support across budgets, actual costs, commitments, accruals, estimate to complete, estimate at completion, and forecast trends.
 Lead or support complex monthly forecast and earned-value reviews, including coordination of inputs, validation of assumptions, and clear explanation of forecast movement.
 Challenge unsupported forecast assumptions and reconcile financial results with current scope, progress, schedule, procurement, and known project risks.
 Analyze material variances and identify the underlying cost drivers, exposure, opportunities, and required corrective actions.
 Support cash-flow modelling and time-phased cost analysis so financial forecasts reflect the expected sequence of project execution.
 Prepare or review concise, defensible reporting for Project Managers and senior leadership, and present technical findings when required.
 Estimating and Preconstruction Support 
 Act as the primary Project Controls contact for the Estimating team on major pursuits identified by the Manager.
 Support development of estimate-stage risk and opportunity registers, preliminary cash flows, execution schedules, contingency assumptions, reporting requirements, and Project Controls staffing plans.
 Challenge schedule, risk, cash-flow, cost, and execution assumptions before submission and identify gaps that may affect project delivery.
 Estimate to Execution Handover 
 Help establish the project control structure before award, including the work breakdown structure, cost and reporting framework, forecast approach, and initial control requirements.
 Participate in the estimate-to-execution handover for awarded projects and ensure key assumptions, risks, opportunities, cash flows, schedules, and contingency considerations are transferred clearly.
 Support the project team in reconciling the awarded estimate with the executed contract, baseline, procurement plan, initial forecast, and reporting requirements.
 Project Controls Standards Systems and Continuous Improvement 
 Develop and maintain reusable standards, templates, calculation methods, and examples for complex Project Controls work.
 Promote consistent, auditable methods across Project Controls systems and reporting outputs, and identify data-quality or control weaknesses.
 Work with the Supervisor, Manager, and team members to turn recurring issues into scalable process and training improvements.
 Risk Opportunity Schedule and Change Support 
 Guide project teams in identifying, assessing, and tracking material risks, opportunities, changes, and cost exposures.
 Ensure approved changes and material risk responses are reflected consistently in forecasts, cash flows, schedules, budgets, and reporting.
 Review schedule updates and key milestones to understand their effect on cost, productivity, billing, contingency, and project execution.
 Assigned Portfolio and Capacity 
 Carry approximately 30-50% of a standard Project Controller portfolio, generally zero to two Project Managers, with the assignment adjusted to current technical and estimating demand.
 Maintain full ownership of routine Project Controls responsibilities for any assigned projects while protecting the capacity required for team-wide support and major pursuits.
 Additional Information     
 As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to complete pre-employment screening including professional reference checks and a criminal record check.
 What We're Looking For 
 Typically 5+ years of experience in project controls, cost control, project accounting, construction finance, or an adjacent discipline. Strong candidates with fewer years may be considered where they demonstrate equivalent technical depth and readiness for the role.
 Demonstrated in-depth cost-control experience, including budget management, commitments, accruals, cost-to-complete forecasting, variance analysis, and forecast development.
 Strong understanding of how cost, schedule, progress, change, risk, cash flow, invoicing, and commercial requirements interact across the project lifecycle.
 Experience producing and explaining project financial reporting for Project Managers, operational leaders, and senior management.
 Advanced Excel capability and experience working with structured project-control, cost, or scheduling systems.
 Ability to analyze unfamiliar problems, form a defensible recommendation, and communicate complex technical matters clearly.
 Ability to coach and influence others without relying on formal authority.
 Comfort working in a growing company where processes are still developing, with the initiative and judgment to help build practical, scalable solutions.
 Experience applying Total Cost Management (TCM) principles or a comparable integrated cost-management framework.
 Experience supporting estimating or preconstruction on major projects, including risk, opportunity, cash-flow, schedule, contingency, or Project Controls planning.
 Experience with InEight, Vista, P6, Power BI, or similar cost, scheduling, and reporting tools.
 Experience in renewable energy, transmission, distribution, high-voltage electrical construction, heavy civil construction, or another adjacent project environment.
 Experience developing or scaling Project Controls standards, templates, processes, or governance within a growing organization.
 What We Offer 
 Competitive compensation with weekly pay periods 
 Generous paid time off   
 RRSP-DPSP employer matching, increasing with years of service  
 Comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, and disability)  
 Ongoing training, development, and career advancement opportunities 
 Employee Assistance Program (confidential counselling support) 
 Employee Referral Bonus Program  
 Why Rising Edge Group?   
 Safety & Excellence:   Safety is at the heart of everything we do.  Every project is approached with diligence, strategic planning, and reliable execution practices to protect our teams and the clients we serve while delivering world-class high-voltage solutions. Our unwavering commitment to safety and quality drives excellence on every project, every day.   
 People-First Culture :  You’re more than a job title.  Every person contributes to powering essential energy infrastructure across North America. Our teams are built on collaboration, respect, and accountability. We support our employees through meaningful engagement initiatives, team events, and a culture that prioritizes wellbeing, inclusion, and genuine lasting connections.                                                                                             
 Career Growth & Impact :  Your role is a path to a long-term career.  We empower our employees with hands-on experience, exposure to diverse projects, and opportunities to advance across disciplines, locations, and career paths. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development, you’ll build lasting expertise while making a tangible impact in an environment where teamwork and integrity guide our work. 
 Reward & Recognition :  We believe skill, dedication, and excellence deserves recognition . Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a strong culture of appreciation ensure your achievements are celebrated, your growth is supported, and your work truly makes a difference.   
 At Rising Edge Group, you’re not just building projects, you’re building a meaningful career where your work helps power the future, one project at a time.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Customer Activation Manager at Ramp, you’ll help partner-sourced customers improve how they manage their finances. You’ll own a book of approximately 80 customers, guiding them through implementation and helping their teams adopt new workflows, including Ramp’s AI and agentic finance capabilities.

This role goes beyond getting customers live. You’ll work with finance leaders, their teams, and external partners to understand what needs to change, address resistance, and make sure customers see measurable value from Ramp. We’re looking for someone who’s led customers through change, is comfortable working with CFOs and Controllers, and uses AI regularly in their own work.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Guide partner-sourced customers from implementation through ongoing workflow adoption, with accountability for time to value and business outcomes.

 - Build a change management plan for each account: identify stakeholders, understand what’s slowing adoption, and help customer teams work through it.

 - Help CFOs and Controllers measure Ramp’s impact, including improvements in close cycles, spend visibility, variance reduction, and ROI.

 - Manage relationships across the customer’s organization, including finance leadership relationships you’ll own independently.

 - Use AI to prepare for calls, build customer materials, synthesize data, spot account risks, and reduce repetitive work.

 - Help customers evaluate and adopt Ramp’s agentic finance capabilities, including the changes these workflows require in their teams’ day-to-day work.

 - Work with Channel Partner Managers, Partner Consulting, Account Executives, and Technical Consulting to coordinate implementations and identify opportunities to expand Ramp’s use.

 - Share recurring customer needs, product gaps, and feedback with Product.

 - 5+ years in customer success, consulting, implementations, or a similar customer-facing role, with a consistent record of delivering customer outcomes and exceeding goals.

 - Experience driving workflow adoption and managing organizational change, including navigating stakeholder resistance. Finance or fintech experience is helpful but not required.

 - Regular, hands-on use of AI to prepare for calls, synthesize information, create customer-facing materials, and automate repetitive tasks.

 - The ability to build a business case for workflow changes and explain their financial impact to CFOs and Controllers, connecting implementation progress to business results.

 - Enough technical depth to work with Product and Engineering on integrations, APIs, and workflow design, and explain those topics to customers.

 - Success in a fast-paced GTM environment, ideally at a SaaS or fintech company.

 - Strong collaboration skills and the ability to get work done across Sales, Product, Operations, and other GTM teams.

 - Familiarity with FP&A, accounting platforms such as NetSuite, Sage, QuickBooks, or Xero, expense management, or other finance workflows.

 - Measurable results in expansion, retention, or time to value.

 - Experience at a company where AI was central to the product or how the team worked.

 - Experience managing 50+ customers at once, prioritizing across accounts, and turning open-ended problems into clear plans.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 As a platform company powering businesses all over the world, Stripe processes payments, runs marketplaces, detects fraud, helps entrepreneurs start internet businesses from anywhere in the world, builds world-class developer-friendly APIs, and more. The engineering teams at Stripe work on the business logic for all of that. As a software engineering manager at Stripe, you'll lead teams that build and expand APIs, services, and experiences. You'll also work with partners to launch new markets and vertical capabilities.
 Stripe Terminal helps our users extend their online presence to the physical world. The mission of the Terminal team is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as the Stripe API has done for online payments—building for Unified Commerce. With Terminal, businesses can unify their in-person and online experiences, unlocking payments use cases that are right for their business model—whether it's creating a modern retail experience, extending their website to a pop-up store, or enabling a mobile point-of-sale at their next event.
 Within Terminal, the Commerce team focuses on the following to help make Unified Commerce a reality for businesses across the globe.
 Enterprise features—on-reader forms, tipping, gift cards
 Payment features—DCC, surcharge, multi-capture
 Point-of-sale integrations—enterprise-focused integrations
 Low-code and no-code—solutions that will enable our users to onboard quickly
 What you'll do
 As an Engineering Manager on the Terminal Commerce Experience team, you'll launch and scale Unified Commerce experiences within Stripe Terminal, drive new end-customer and merchant features, and build POS integrations from the ground up to support large-scale enterprise.

 Work with leaders across Stripe to create and drive toward the vision of Unified Commerce, bringing in-person and online payments together
 Drive the roadmap and priorities for your team, and work with dependencies across the company
 Support the engineering team in achieving a high level of technical excellence and stability
 Manage processes to help the team do its best work and interface effectively with the rest of Stripe
 Recruit excellent engineers in collaboration with the Stripe recruiting team and develop engineers on the team, helping them advance in their careers
 Understand core Stripe APIs, influence design to interplay with card-present payments, and build a platform for Unified Commerce with your team
 Empower and guide your team to build and scale integrations and core abstractions across payment methods, gift cards, and point-of-sale connectors for large-scale enterprise
 Drive table stakes features like surcharging and tipping across Enterprise and SaaS platform merchants

 Experience building diverse teams to tackle challenging technical problems
 An understanding of the impact of AI and a strong product mindset to turn emerging capabilities into clear customer and business value
 Experience thriving in a collaborative environment involving different stakeholders and subject matter experts
 Understanding of how to build and manage scalable, resilient, and observable systems across the stack
 The ability to listen well and internalize the best ideas from all over the organization while also setting a vision that others are excited to get behind
 The ability to put yourself in the shoes of our merchants and users
 Experience leading large technical projects with internal and external dependencies and impact across many teams

 Industry experience building or managing teams who have built in-person checkout experiences or payment method integrations
 Experience with in-person payments hardware and software such as card readers and firmware
 A deep understanding of the payments industry as a whole

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



Device Infrastructure Services owns the full lifecycle of hardware and operating systems across 1Password. The team is looking for the Staff Engineer who will lead its next chapter: a deliberate shift from legacy device management patterns towards devops and AI-enabled operations.



You'll be the technical leader of this team, responsible for setting the roadmap for this transformation and making sure it gets executed. This isn't a role where you hand off a roadmap and step back: you'll be in the build alongside the team, coaching engineers and raising the ceiling on what they're capable of. If you're excited by building scalable systems, shaping the strategy behind tools the whole company depends on, and bringing out the best work in the people around you, we want to hear from you.





How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

 - 7+ years of IT and enterprise endpoint management experience, including 2+ years at a senior or staff IC level, with a track record of building and managing endpoints with Gitops practices.

 - Demonstrate broad knowledge of enterprise endpoint management, deep operating system-level experience, and the ability to recognize patterns across a fleet and build fixes that prevent recurrence.

 - Practical experience using AI tools to enable or accelerate IT operations and the judgment to know where AI speeds things up versus where it introduces risk.

 - Proven ability to define and drive technical roadmaps, seeing around corners and balancing long-term vision with near-term execution.

 -  Strong scripting and IaC ability (Bash, Python, and Terraform at minimum) — both writing production-quality automation yourself and reviewing others' code with a critical eye.

 -  Deep working knowledge of enterprise security fundamentals as they apply to endpoints: encryption, patch/vulnerability management, EDR, least-privilege enforcement, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar).

 - Lead through change, collaborate effectively, and mentor engineers while maintaining a focused and impactful team environment.





What you can expect:

 - Own the technical direction of our Device Infrastructure Services, the tooling and standards that keep ~2,000 endpoints compliant, configured, and secure.

 - Drive the technical direction of a DevOps operating model for the fleet — config-as-code, version control, code review, and CI/CD pipelines in place of manual console changes — and drive adoption of that model across the IT team.

 -  Lead the adoption of responsible agentic AI across the device team, building the guardrails that decide what agents can act on autonomously and what still needs a human checkpoint.

 -  Act as the final escalation point for high-severity endpoint incidents, including deep machine-level diagnosis on both macOS and Windows hardware.

 - Partner across IT, Security, and product teams building custom solutions and helping push their initiatives across the finish line.

 - Assess and pilot new tooling (e.g., MDM platform migrations, patch management systems) and drive build-vs-buy decisions.

 - Collaborate with product teams to advise on features from the perspective of a real-world enterprise device deployment, and lead Customer Zero initiatives — piloting and stress-testing our own product against our internal fleet before it reaches customers.



What success looks like:

 - Establishing a clear 12-month roadmap for the transition to a GitOps-based operating model.

 - Building device health metrics and remediation standards for machine security, performance, and employee experience.

 - Developing our AI-assisted operations strategy, with automation milestones that balance speed, human review, security and agentic workflows.

 - Supporting the unpredictable release cadence of major OS vendors, and making sure those updates land safely across the org.

 - Bringing the team along with you — at 1Password, we Put People First. This role isn't just about leveling up what we can do technically, it's also about coaching the team along the way.



USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $143,000 USD and $207,000 USD,  plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $122,000 CAD and $177,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

Community

🌎 Remote-first work environment
